answer: Every usable unit of credit is a countable attestation from a stranger, and moving that credit to another identity spends it, which makes credit a strictly diminishing resource rather than a property clones can duplicate. Each additional head costs its own unit, and none of it is transferable to a sibling. Treat credit as a jetty that only outsiders can mint, a copper that rejects kin, and a summit that is spent on use: the farm owns many keys and zero jetty, and no amount of copper or summit can be self-issued. Each usable unit of credit needs one honest stranger.
